title: pvCompositeCellGridReader
body:
## pvCompositeCellGridReader

Reads cell-grid data (.dg JSON files, e.g. discontinuous Galerkin or other high-order results) into a partitioned dataset collection of vtkCellGrid objects, keeping only the selected cell types and cell attributes. Cell grids store fields with their own interpolation rules rather than as ordinary point or cell arrays, so only filters that support vtkCellGrid accept the output directly. It is a distributed reader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Most classic filters (slice, contour, threshold) do not accept cell grids; check that each following operation supports them.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `CompositeCellGridReader`. Identity: `sources/CompositeCellGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellAttributes` | Select the cell attributes to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `CellTypes` | Select the cell types to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The path to a file containing cell-grid JSON data. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCompositeCellGridReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
